title: multiply_polynomialcoeff (fulu-polynomial-commitments-sampling)
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB

    [*] --> q_init : start
    q_init --> q_assert : assert len(a) + len(b) <= FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB
    q_assert --> q_init_r : r = PolynomialCoeff([0])
    q_init_r --> q_iter : for power, coef in enumerate(a)
    q_iter --> q_summand : summand = [0]*power + [coef * x for x in b]
    q_summand --> q_accumulate : r = add_polynomialcoeff(r, summand)
    q_accumulate --> q_iter : next coefficient
    q_iter --> q_return : all coefficients processed
    q_return --> [*] : return r

    note right of q_assert
        INV: Product degree <= FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB - 1
        INV: Result degree = deg(a) + deg(b)
    end note

title: interpolate_polynomialcoeff (fulu-polynomial-commitments-sampling)
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB

    [*] --> q_init : start
    q_init --> q_assert : assert len(xs) == len(ys)
    q_assert --> q_init_r : r = PolynomialCoeff([0])
    q_init_r --> q_outer : for i in range(len(xs))
    q_outer --> q_summand : summand = PolynomialCoeff([ys[i]])
    q_summand --> q_inner : for j in range(len(ys)), j != i
    q_inner --> q_weight : weight_adjustment = (xs[i] - xs[j]).inverse()
    q_weight --> q_multiply : summand = multiply(summand, [-w*xs[j], w])
    q_multiply --> q_inner : next j
    q_inner --> q_accumulate : r = add_polynomialcoeff(r, summand)
    q_accumulate --> q_outer : next i
    q_outer --> q_return : all i processed
    q_return --> [*] : return r

    note right of q_outer
        INV: All xs values must be distinct (for invertibility)
        INV: Result polynomial has degree at most len(xs) - 1
        INV: evaluate(result, xs[i]) == ys[i] for all i
    end note

    [*] --> q_init : start
    q_init --> q_eval : ys = [evaluate_polynomialcoeff(poly, z) for z in zs]
    q_eval --> q_vanish : denominator_poly = vanishing_polynomialcoeff(zs)
    q_vanish --> q_divide : quotient = divide_polynomialcoeff(poly, denominator_poly)
    q_divide --> q_commit : proof = g1_lincomb(KZG_SETUP_G1_MONOMIAL, quotient)
    q_commit --> [*] : return KZGProof(proof), ys

        INV: Q(X) = f(X) / Z(X) where Z vanishes on all evaluation points zs
        INV: deg(Q) = deg(f) - deg(Z) = deg(f) - len(zs)
        INV: Proof is a commitment to the quotient polynomial
    end note
"}

    [*] --> q_init : start
    q_init --> q_assert : assert lengths match and commitments unique
    q_assert --> q_validate : for each commitment_index assert < len(commitments)
    q_validate --> q_setup : num_cells = len(cell_indices), n = FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL
    q_setup --> q_challenge : r = compute_verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_challenge(...)
    q_challenge --> q_powers : r_powers = compute_powers(r, num_cells)
    q_powers --> q_ll : LL = g1_lincomb(proofs, r_powers)
    q_ll --> q_lr : LR = KZG_SETUP_G2_MONOMIAL[n]
    q_lr --> q_weights : weights = [0] * num_commitments
    q_weights --> q_weight_iter : weights[commitment_indices[k]] += r_powers[k]
    q_weight_iter --> q_rlc : all weights accumulated
    q_rlc --> q_interp_init : RLC = g1_lincomb(commitments, weights)
    q_interp_init --> q_interp_iter : sum_interp = PolynomialCoeff([0] * n)
    q_interp_iter --> q_interp_scale : interp_poly = interpolate(coset, cosets_evals[k])
    q_interp_scale --> q_interp_accum : scaled = multiply([r_powers[k]], interp_poly)
    q_interp_accum --> q_interp_iter : sum_interp = add(sum_interp, scaled)
    q_interp_iter --> q_rli : all interpolations done
    q_rli --> q_rlp_init : RLI = g1_lincomb(KZG_SETUP_G1_MONOMIAL[:n], sum_interp)
    q_rlp_init --> q_rlp_iter : h_k = coset_shift_for_cell(cell_indices[k])
    q_rlp_iter --> q_rlp : wrp = r_powers[k] * h_k.pow(n)
    q_rlp --> q_rl : RLP = g1_lincomb(proofs, weighted_r_powers)
    q_rl --> q_pairing : RL = RLC - RLI + RLP
    q_pairing --> [*] : pairing_check([[LL, LR], [RL, neg(G2)]])

    note right of q_challenge
        INV: Verification equation: e(LL, LR) == e(RL, [1])
        INV: Random challenge r binds all inputs via Fiat-Shamir
        INV: Commitments list must contain no duplicates
        INV: All commitment_indices must reference valid entries
        INV: Universal verification aggregates multiple cell proofs into single pairing check
    end note
"}

title: recover_polynomialcoeff (fulu-polynomial-commitments-sampling)
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB

    [*] --> q_init : start
    q_init --> q_domain : roots_ext = compute_roots_of_unity(FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB)
    q_domain --> q_flatten : build extended_evaluation_rbo with zeros for missing cells
    q_flatten --> q_permute : extended_evaluation = bit_reversal_permutation(extended_evaluation_rbo)
    q_permute --> q_missing : missing_cell_indices = cells not in cell_indices
    q_missing --> q_vanish : zero_poly_coeff = construct_vanishing_polynomial(missing_cell_indices)
    q_vanish --> q_zpeval : zero_poly_eval = fft_field(zero_poly_coeff, roots_ext)
    q_zpeval --> q_multiply : ez_eval = [a * b for a, b in zip(zero_poly_eval, extended_evaluation)]
    q_multiply --> q_ifft : ez_coeffs = fft_field(ez_eval, roots_ext, inv=True)
    q_ifft --> q_coset_ez : ez_over_coset = coset_fft_field(ez_coeffs, roots_ext)
    q_coset_ez --> q_coset_zp : zp_over_coset = coset_fft_field(zero_poly_coeff, roots_ext)
    q_coset_zp --> q_divide : reconstructed = [a / b for a, b in zip(ez_over_coset, zp_over_coset)]
    q_divide --> q_icoset : poly_coeff = coset_fft_field(reconstructed, roots_ext, inv=True)
    q_icoset --> [*] : return PolynomialCoeff(poly_coeff[:FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB])

    note right of q_vanish
        INV: E(x) * Z(x) == P(x) * Z(x) over the FFT domain
        INV: Division by Z(x) is done over a coset to avoid division by zero
        INV: Recovered polynomial has degree < FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB
        INV: At least 50% of cells must be available for successful recovery
    end note
"}

title: add_polynomialcoeff (fulu-polynomial-commitments-sampling)
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB

    [*] --> q_init : start
    q_init --> q_order : order a, b so len(a) >= len(b)
    q_order --> q_lengths : length_a = len(a), length_b = len(b)
    q_lengths --> q_iter : i < length_a
    q_iter --> q_add : result[i] = a[i] + (b[i] if i < length_b else 0)
    q_add --> q_iter : i < length_a
    q_add --> q_return : i >= length_a
    q_return --> [*] : return PolynomialCoeff(result)

    note right of q_iter
        INV: Result degree = max(deg(a), deg(b))
        INV: Shorter polynomial is zero-padded for missing coefficients
    end note
"}

{"content":"---
title: divide_polynomialcoeff (fulu-polynomial-commitments-sampling)
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB

    [*] --> q_init : start
    q_init --> q_copy : a = copy(a)
    q_copy --> q_init_vars : o = [], apos = len(a) - 1, bpos = len(b) - 1
    q_init_vars --> q_check_diff : diff = apos - bpos
    q_check_diff --> q_quot : diff >= 0
    q_check_diff --> q_return : diff < 0
    q_quot --> q_compute : quot = a[apos] / b[bpos]
    q_compute --> q_prepend : o.insert(0, quot)
    q_prepend --> q_subtract : a[diff + i] -= b[i] * quot
    q_subtract --> q_decrement : apos -= 1, diff -= 1
    q_decrement --> q_check_diff : diff = apos - bpos
    q_return --> [*] : return o

    note right of q_check_diff
        INV: b must not be the zero polynomial
        INV: a = quotient * b + remainder (remainder is discarded)
        INV: Leading coefficient of b (b[bpos]) must be nonzero
    end note
"}

---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB

    [*] --> q_init : start
    q_init --> q_iter : p = PolynomialCoeff([1])
    q_iter --> q_multiply : for x in xs
    q_multiply --> q_iter : p = multiply_polynomialcoeff(p, [-x, 1])
    q_iter --> q_return : all xs processed
    q_return --> [*] : return p

    note right of q_iter
        INV: Result polynomial evaluates to 0 at every point in xs
        INV: Result has degree exactly len(xs)
        INV: Leading coefficient is 1 (monic polynomial)
    end note
"}

title: construct_vanishing_polynomial (fulu-polynomial-commitments-sampling)
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB

    [*] --> q_init : start
    q_init --> q_roots : roots_reduced = compute_roots_of_unity(CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB)
    q_roots --> q_vanish : short_zero_poly = vanishing_polynomialcoeff(missing roots with bit-reversal)
    q_vanish --> q_init_ext : zero_poly_coeff = [0] * FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB
    q_init_ext --> q_extend : for i, coeff in enumerate(short_zero_poly)
    q_extend --> q_assign : zero_poly_coeff[i * FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL] = coeff
    q_assign --> q_extend : next coefficient
    q_extend --> q_return : all coefficients placed
    q_return --> [*] : return zero_poly_coeff

    note right of q_vanish
        INV: At least one cell must be present (not all can be missing)
        INV: Vanishing polynomial evaluates to 0 at all missing cell evaluation points
        INV: Coefficient spacing by FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL extends polynomial to full domain
    end note
"}

title: cell_to_coset_evals (fulu-polynomial-commitments-sampling)
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB

    [*] --> q_init : start
    q_init --> q_init_evals : evals = CosetEvals()
    q_init_evals --> q_iter : i = 0
    q_iter --> q_compute : i < FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL
    q_iter --> q_return : i >= FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL
    q_compute --> q_convert : start = i * BYTES_PER_FIELD_ELEMENT
    q_convert --> q_assign : end = (i + 1) * BYTES_PER_FIELD_ELEMENT
    q_assign --> q_iter : evals[i] = bytes_to_bls_field(cell[start:end])
    q_return --> [*] : return evals

    note right of q_iter
        INV: Each cell byte segment [start:end] is exactly BYTES_PER_FIELD_ELEMENT bytes
        INV: Output CosetEvals has exactly FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL elements
    end note
"}

    20→func DataColumnsAlignWithBlock(block blocks.ROBlock, dataColumns []blocks.RODataColumn) error {
    21→	// No data columns before Fulu.
    22→	if block.Version() < version.Fulu {
    23→		return nil
    24→	}
    25→
    26→	// Compute the maximum number of blobs per block.
    27→	blockSlot := block.Block().Slot()
    28→	maxBlobsPerBlock := params.BeaconConfig().MaxBlobsPerBlock(blockSlot)
    29→
    30→	// Check if the block has not too many commitments.
    31→	blockCommitments, err := block.Block().Body().BlobKzgCommitments()
    32→	if err != nil {
    33→		return errors.Wrap(err, "blob KZG commitments")
    34→	}
    35→
    36→	blockCommitmentCount := len(blockCommitments)
    37→	if blockCommitmentCount > maxBlobsPerBlock {
    38→		return ErrTooManyCommitments
    39→	}
    40→
    41→	blockRoot := block.Root()
    42→
    43→	for _, dataColumn := range dataColumns {

    45→		if dataColumn.BlockRoot() != blockRoot {
    46→			return ErrRootMismatch
    47→		}
    48→
    49→		// Check if the content length of the data column sidecar matches the block.

    52→			len(dataColumn.KzgProofs) != blockCommitmentCount {
    53→			return ErrBlockColumnSizeMismatch
    54→		}
    55→
    56→		// Check if the commitments of the data column sidecar match the block.
    57→		for i := range blockCommitments {

    59→				return ErrCommitmentMismatch
    60→			}
    61→		}
    62→	}

    34→// CustodyGroups computes the custody groups the node should participate in for custody.
    35→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/das-core.md#get_custody_groups
    36→func CustodyGroups(nodeId enode.ID, custodyGroupCount uint64) ([]uint64, error) {
    37→	numberOfCustodyGroups := params.BeaconConfig().NumberOfCustodyGroups
    38→
    39→	// Check if the custody group count is larger than the number of custody groups.
    40→	if custodyGroupCount > numberOfCustodyGroups {
    41→		return nil, ErrCustodyGroupCountTooLarge
    42→	}
    43→
    44→	// Shortcut if all custody groups are needed.
    45→	if custodyGroupCount == numberOfCustodyGroups {
    46→		custodyGroups := make([]uint64, 0, numberOfCustodyGroups)
    47→		for i := range numberOfCustodyGroups {
    48→			custodyGroups = append(custodyGroups, i)
    49→		}
    50→
    51→		return custodyGroups, nil
    52→	}
    53→
    54→	one := uint256.NewInt(1)
    55→
    56→	custodyGroupsMap := make(map[uint64]bool, custodyGroupCount)
    57→	custodyGroups := make([]uint64, 0, custodyGroupCount)
    58→	for currentId := new(uint256.Int).SetBytes(nodeId.Bytes()); uint64(len(custodyGroups)) < custodyGroupCount; {
    59→		// Convert to big endian bytes.
    60→		currentIdBytesBigEndian := currentId.Bytes32()
    61→
    62→		// Convert to little endian.
    63→		currentIdBytesLittleEndian := bytesutil.ReverseByteOrder(currentIdBytesBigEndian[:])
    64→
    65→		// Hash the result.
    66→		hashedCurrentId := hash.Hash(currentIdBytesLittleEndian)
    67→
    68→		// Get the custody group ID.
    69→		custodyGroup := binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(hashedCurrentId[:8]) % numberOfCustodyGroups
    70→
    71→		// Add the custody group to the map.
    72→		if !custodyGroupsMap[custodyGroup] {
    73→			custodyGroupsMap[custodyGroup] = true
    74→			custodyGroups = append(custodyGroups, custodyGroup)
    75→		}
    76→
    77→		if currentId.Cmp(maxUint256) == 0 {
    78→			// Overflow prevention.
    79→			currentId = uint256.NewInt(0)
    80→		} else {

    82→			currentId.Add(currentId, one)
    83→		}
    84→	}

    87→	if uint64(len(custodyGroups)) != custodyGroupCount {
    88→		return nil, errWrongComputedCustodyGroupCount
    89→	}

    92→	slices.Sort[[]uint64](custodyGroups)

    97→// ComputeColumnsForCustodyGroup computes the columns for a given custody group.
    98→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/das-core.md#compute_columns_for_custody_group
    99→func ComputeColumnsForCustodyGroup(custodyGroup uint64) ([]uint64, error) {
   100→	beaconConfig := params.BeaconConfig()

   102→

   109→	columnsPerGroup := numberOfColumns / numberOfCustodyGroups

   113→		column := numberOfCustodyGroups*i + custodyGroup
   114→		columns = append(columns, column)

   120→// DataColumnSidecars computes the data column sidecars from the signed block, cells and cell proofs.
   121→// The returned value contains pointers to function parameters.
   122→// (If the caller alterates `cellsAndProofs` afterwards, the returned value will be modified as well.)
   123→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/validator.md#get_data_column_sidecars_from_block
   124→func DataColumnSidecars(signedBlock interfaces.ReadOnlySignedBeaconBlock, cellsAndProofs []kzg.CellsAndProofs) ([]*ethpb.DataColumnSidecar, error) {
   125→	if signedBlock == nil || signedBlock.IsNil() || len(cellsAndProofs) == 0 {
   126→		return nil, nil
   127→	}
   128→
   129→	block := signedBlock.Block()
   130→	blockBody := block.Body()
   131→	blobKzgCommitments, err := blockBody.BlobKzgCommitments()
   132→	if err != nil {
   133→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "blob KZG commitments")
   134→	}

   136→	if len(blobKzgCommitments) != len(cellsAndProofs) {
   137→		return nil, ErrSizeMismatch

   140→	signedBlockHeader, err := signedBlock.Header()
   141→	if err != nil {
   142→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "signed block header")

   146→	if err != nil {

   148→	}
   149→
   150→	dataColumnSidecars, err := dataColumnsSidecars(signedBlockHeader, blobKzgCommitments, kzgCommitmentsInclusionProof, cellsAndProofs)
   151→	if err != nil {
   152→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "data column sidecars")

   180→	for _, group := range custodyGroups {

   198→// dataColumnsSidecars computes the data column sidecars from the signed block header, the blob KZG commiments,
   199→// the KZG commitment includion proofs and cells and cell proofs.
   200→// The returned value contains pointers to function parameters.
   201→// (If the caller alterates input parameters afterwards, the returned value will be modified as well.)
   202→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/validator.md#get_data_column_sidecars
   203→func dataColumnsSidecars(
   204→	signedBlockHeader *ethpb.SignedBeaconBlockHeader,
   205→	blobKzgCommitments [][]byte,
   206→	kzgCommitmentsInclusionProof [][]byte,
   207→	cellsAndProofs []kzg.CellsAndProofs,
   208→) ([]*ethpb.DataColumnSidecar, error) {
   209→	start := time.Now()
   210→	if len(blobKzgCommitments) != len(cellsAndProofs) {
   211→		return nil, ErrSizeMismatch
   212→	}
   213→
   214→	numberOfColumns := params.BeaconConfig().NumberOfColumns

   216→	blobsCount := len(cellsAndProofs)
   217→	sidecars := make([]*ethpb.DataColumnSidecar, 0, numberOfColumns)
   218→	for columnIndex := range numberOfColumns {
   219→		column := make([]kzg.Cell, 0, blobsCount)
   220→		kzgProofOfColumn := make([]kzg.Proof, 0, blobsCount)
   221→
   222→		for rowIndex := range blobsCount {
   223→			cellsForRow := cellsAndProofs[rowIndex].Cells
   224→			proofsForRow := cellsAndProofs[rowIndex].Proofs
   225→
   226→			// Validate that we have enough cells and proofs for this column index
   227→			if columnIndex >= uint64(len(cellsForRow)) {

   231→				return nil, errors.Errorf("column index %d exceeds proofs length %d for blob %d", columnIndex, len(proofsForRow), rowIndex)
   232→			}
   233→
   234→			cell := cellsForRow[columnIndex]
   235→			column = append(column, cell)
   236→
   237→			kzgProof := proofsForRow[columnIndex]
   238→			kzgProofOfColumn = append(kzgProofOfColumn, kzgProof)
   239→		}
   240→
   241→		columnBytes := make([][]byte, 0, blobsCount)
   242→		for i := range column {
   243→			columnBytes = append(columnBytes, column[i][:])
   244→		}
   245→
   246→		kzgProofOfColumnBytes := make([][]byte, 0, blobsCount)
   247→		for _, kzgProof := range kzgProofOfColumn {
   248→			kzgProofOfColumnBytes = append(kzgProofOfColumnBytes, kzgProof[:])
   249→		}
   250→
   251→		sidecar := &ethpb.DataColumnSidecar{
